name: Field Report
description: A scroll-first research-publication system: warm paper grounds, near-black report type, hairline rules and oversized graphic letterforms, with lavender, cyan and green appearing only as translucent material signals.
whenToUse: Pick for an investigated argument that wants to look researched rather than marketed: a science or sustainability field report, an impact or materials-transition study, a campaign whitepaper, a data-led editorial. The chain is a quiet orientation toolbar, a full-screen typographic cover with faint orbital marks, a two-column reading spread with a sourced quote in the counter-column, a full-bleed chapter divider, an evidence spread pairing report copy with an oversized circular fact set, a calm closing invitation and a source-credit footer. Every section works without JavaScript; the only motion is CSS scroll-entry and one slow orbit, both with a reduced-motion fallback. Prefer Editorial for a magazine feature carried by a serif, and Annual Report for corporate results and financial charts.
